entities.name: Query UDP-MurNAc ligase
observations: 509-aa query protein has 39.6–41.9% identity and 92.9–98.4% query coverage to reviewed cyanobacterial UDP-MurNAc-L-Ala-D-Glu–meso-diaminopimelate ligases; function is homolog-supported, not directly assayed for this sequence.
Homolog annotations assign EC 6.3.2.13 and Mg2+ dependence.

entities.name: MurNAc-DAP ligation
observations: ATP-dependent ligation: UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-muramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate + meso-2,6-diaminopimelate + ATP → UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-muramoyl-L-alanyl-gamma-D-glutamyl-meso-2,6-diaminopimelate + ADP + phosphate + H+ (Rhea:23676).

entities.name: Peptidoglycan biosynthesis
observations: UDP-MurNAc-L-Ala-D-Glu–meso-diaminopimelate ligases participate in bacterial cell-wall peptidoglycan precursor biosynthesis.
